subject: Homework transmission: backend exercise, deadline & reviewer rotation

Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Homework transmission: backend exercise, deadline & reviewer rotation

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for taking the interview loop with us yesterday. As discussed, attached is the take-home backend exercise. A few quick notes:

- Goal: implement a small service that exposes two endpoints and a lightweight integration test. Focus on correctness, clarity, and testability rather than production-grade perf.
- Format: one repo archive or a single zip with README and tests. Please include short run instructions.
- Deadline: 96 hours from now — submit by Sun, Nov 7 09:12 PT. If you need a short extension, let us know; we can usually grant one extra 48-hour window for scheduling conflicts.
- Time expectation: aim for ~3–4 hours of work. We don't expect a polished production system.

Attachments: backend_takehome_prompt.pdf (assignment + grading rubric)
Submission: reply to this thread with a GitHub link (private link acceptable) or attach the archive.

Reviewer plan: I'm looping in Marissa, Grace, and Aditya to staff reviewers. We generally assign a primary reviewer and one secondary; turnaround target is 48 hours from submission.

If anything in the prompt is unclear, reply here and I'll clarify. Good luck — excited to see your solution!

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
